description:
Are you an enthusiastic gravel biker, always in search of new adventures?

Do you dream of multi-day bikepacking tours in the great outdoors?

Your current gravel bike lacks the necessary attachment points for that, and to be honest, those 40mm-wide “gravel tires” of yours don’t provide much fun off the beaten path when loaded with luggage, do they?

If you find yourself yearning for more off-road adventures, it’s high time to explore the captivating world of true bikepacking with the 8bar TFLSBERG V3!

RIDE RELAXED

The TFLSBERG V3 features a geometry for loooong days in the saddle, providing a relaxed and comfortable riding position. Unlike our Gravel Allrounder, the 8bar MITTE, this bike ensures you’ll enjoy every Kilometer with ease, as you embark on unforgettable adventures!

NEW UDH DROPOUTS

The Universal Derailleur Hanger (UDH) is a new standard that simplifies bike maintenance and improves compatibility across brands. With UDH on our 8bar TFLSBERG V3, you can easily find replacement parts, as it works universally with various bikes. It ensures smoother, more precise shifting and helps align the derailleur for optimal performance. Plus, UDH is future-proof, keeping your bike compatible with upcoming technologies. This feature makes repairs easier and ensures a hassle-free riding experience.

TRANSPORT WATER – A LOT OF WATER

The TFLSBERG V3 is a beverage oasis, ensuring you have enough liquid to keep you going. With space for up to five (or nine if you count the Anything Cage mounts on the fork and rear frame) bottle cages. In addition to the conventional positions in the frame triangle, it offers two more on the side and an extra one on the downside of the down tube.

ADD ANYTHING YOU LIKE

Alongside the usual eyelets on the fork, we’ve added two more mounting options on the frame and fork, providing space for four Anything Cages. This ingenious setup ensures a balanced weight distribution across the entire bike, bringing the center of gravity down. The result? Compared to a conventionally packed Gravel Bike, you’ll experience much more fun on the trail, with enhanced stability and agility to conquer any terrain with ease!

CURVED SEATSTAYS

Your comfort is our priority on those longer tours! That’s why the TFLSBERG V3 comes with curved seat stays, providing you with increased flex for a smoother ride. This thoughtful design also prevents your luggage, attached to the seat stays, from coming into contact with your heels.

BIG TIRE CLEARANCE

At 8bar Bikes, we firmly believe that bigger is better! While 27.5″ tires may have been the go-to choice in the past, we’ve set a new benchmark with the TFLSBERG V3 – 29″ tires are now the way to go! If you’ve ever found yourself struggling with a fully loaded 40mm “gravel tire” on a rooted trail, then you’ll truly appreciate why we designed the TFLSBERG V3 to accommodate up to 29×2.25″ tires or 27.5×2.8″ tires.

REINFORCED FRAME CONSTRUCTION

The TFLSBERG is purpose-built for off-road bikepacking adventures. We know that these tours can subject your bike to extreme loads, so we’ve reinforced the head tube area and used tubes with thicker wall thicknesses in the weld area. To ensure it can handle the challenges you’ll face on your journey. With this robust construction, you can ride with confidence, knowing that your TFLSBERG is ready to take on any terrain!

INTERNAL DROPPER SEATPOST READY

Thanks to our specially prepared cable guide, you can easily install a dropper seatpost on the TFLSBERG. This fantastic feature allows you to adjust your saddle on the go, adapting to various terrain conditions during your tour.
